newsitem.title: USA: Finish Line accelerates growth plans.
newsitem.headline: Finish Line accelerates growth plans.

text.p: Finish Line Inc said Friday it accelerated growth plans for the current fiscal year, ending February 28, 1998, with plans to increase retail square footage by 40 to 45 percent, up from the previously planned 35 percent increase.
In fiscal 1997, ended March 1, it grew retail square footage by 25 percent, bringing its total square footage to 1,088,000.

"Due to the acceptance of our new store formats by mall developers, the availability of quality mall locations, our strengthened infrastructure and our strong financial condition, we are prepared to take advantage of present opportunities by increasing our retail square footage from our previously announced 35 percent increase to an increase of approximately 40 percent to 45 percent for fiscal 1998," Alan Cohen, president, said in a statement.
This equates to total increased square footage for the full fiscal year of between 435,000 to 490,000, he added.

Cohen said the planned increase includes both adding new stores and accelerating the remodeling/expansion program. He said the company now plans to add 50 to 60 new stores and to remodel 10 to 15 existing stores in fiscal 1998.
"As part of this acceleration, we plan to open stores in at least four new states: New Jersey, Massachusetts, Connecticut and New Hampshire," Cohen said.

Finish Line is a specialty retailer of men's, women's, and children's brand name athletic and lifestyle footwear, activewear and accessories. The company currently operates 260 stores in 27 states, principally in the Midwest, South and Southeast.
